about: Known parity items that are not good, each pinned to its exact failure (lane H4; parity_grandfather.py has the format and the matching rules). An entry excuses its item only while every recorded field is the same: status, rsFailure, the case identity, Go's result, the attempt list of the mode and the fingerprint of every attempt (outcome, exit code, sha256 of stdout, of stderr in its site form and of the written files, inputs intact; the site form replaces the Rust line number of tsc-rs's port-site line, version 4 (lane H6, domain-tagged)). Anything else fails the gate, and so does an entry whose item is good now. parity_compare.py reads this file at the accepted ref. Regenerate entries with `parity_grandfather.py regen`; add an item only with a reason a reviewer can check. The 35 fuzz cases of the full batch where Go itself crashes or times out and tsc-rs does too (listed by lane H3, from runs/h2-head-efef52257-full-2; evidence regenerated by lane H4 and, in the site form, by lane H6), and fuzz/1:5391. The api entries (lane H7, `regen --only '^api/'`) are known-bad tracking entries: confirmed output differences of tsc-rs from Go on the API path whose fix lane is open; that lane removes them.

api/build-mixed-dirs-insensitive.reason: Known-bad tracking entry (lane H7), not an accepted difference: a confirmed output difference of tsc-rs from pinned Go on the API path. D2 family, not attributed further: the build orchestrator's out/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo on an insensitive host has root [[1,3]] in Go and [[2,3]] in tsc-rs (the root A/x.ts is not matched to its fileNames entry ../a/x.ts); every other output is equal. Fix lane B2 is open and removes this entry when the item MATCHes; any other change of this failure fails the gate.

api/case-json-overwrite-insensitive.reason: Known-bad tracking entry (lane H7), not an accepted difference: a confirmed output difference of tsc-rs from pinned Go on the API path. B3 D2: the emit side takes its case sensitivity from the OS (program/go_frontend.rs build_program and publish_parsed_files, osvfs_fs()), not from the session's filesystem (--useCaseSensitiveFileNames=false). B3 c1b: Go emits no SRC/data.json (it would overwrite src/data.json on this host), tsc-rs emits it. Fix lane B2 is open and removes this entry when the item MATCHes; any other change of this failure fails the gate.

fuzz/1:5391.reason: Regression tracking of a known output DIFF, not acceptance (root, 2026-11-05): this item is not good. Go's --traceResolution output for one package.json lookup reads 'File '<x>/package.json' does not exist according to earlier cached lookups.' in Go's default runs, and tsc-rs always prints 'File '<x>/package.json' does not exist.' instead, which suggests a cached-lookup path the port may lack (on root's compiler backlog). Go itself varies between the two forms at --checkers 2 and 12 and in older fills (the race of fuzz/1:23080). Any change of tsc-rs's or Go's output here fails the gate; if a Go fill shows the race at the defaults the item is GO-BROKEN and this entry is stale: remove it then.
